Bấm vào biểu tượng nút loa bên cạnh từng đáp án để luyện nghe phát âm chuẩn giọng Mỹ!
A

LISTENING (2.0 points)

10 câu hỏi

Bài nghe chính: Leisure Time Survey

Giọng đọc chuẩn Anh-Mỹ (US Female) • Nghe các bạn Sakura, Eric & Lan chia sẻ

Sẵn sàng nghe

I. Listen and choose the best answer (1–5)

Chọn 1 đáp án đúng

1. What is Sakura keen on?

2. Where does Eric usually go in winter?

3. What does Lan often do in her free time?

4. Who does Lan play with?

5. What benefit does Eric get from skiing?

II. Listen and decide True (T) or False (F) (6–10)

Chọn True hoặc False
6. Sakura does origami on her own.
7. Eric goes skiing with friends.
8. Lan plays badminton every day.
9. Badminton helps Lan reduce stress.
10. Eric lives far from ski resorts.

VOCABULARY AND GRAMMAR (3.0 points)

17 câu hỏi

I. Choose the best answer (11–20)

13. She is interested in ______ origami with her sister.

14. He likes ______ to ski resorts in winter.

15. We often ______ badminton every afternoon.

16. Do you fancy ______ for a walk in the park?

17. Would you like ______ the cooking club with me?

18. Playing sport helps ______ stress and stay fit.

19. She lives ______ me, right next door.

20. Leisure activities help students stay ______ and happy.

Chọn 1 phần chứa lỗi sai

Chọn dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc

26. They (spend) ______ time (do) ______ origami in the evening.

27. She (be) ______ keen on (ski) ______ in winter.

C

READING (2.4 points)

12 câu hỏi

I. Picture / Sign Interpretation (28)

28. A sign says: “No skiing here.” What does it mean?

II. Cloze passage (29–33)

Đọc đoạn văn và chọn từ thích hợp để điền vào chỗ trống

Eric lives near a ski resort. In winter, he enjoys (29) ______ with his parents. He is keen on skiing because it helps him (30) ______ health and balance. At weekends, he goes there almost (31) ______ afternoon. He also (32) ______ snowboarding with his friends. These activities help him (33) ______ stress.

III. Reading passage comprehension (34–39)

Sakura is from Japan. She likes origami very much. She often does paper folding on her own at home. It helps her relax after school.

Eric is from Switzerland. He enjoys skiing and snowboarding at ski resorts near his hometown. He usually goes there with his parents. These activities help him improve his health and balance.

Lan is from Vietnam. She plays badminton with her best friend who lives next door. They play almost every afternoon. It helps her improve muscle strength and reduce stress.

34. What is the best title for the passage?

35. Sakura does origami ______.

36. Eric goes skiing with ______.

37. Badminton helps Lan ______.

38. Which activity is NOT mentioned in the reading passage?

39. What is the main idea of the text?

D

WRITING (2.6 points)

8 câu tự gõ ngắn

I. Rearrange the words to make complete sentences (40–42)

Sắp xếp các từ bị xáo trộn thành câu hoàn chỉnh và gõ vào ô trả lời bên dưới:

Question 40: play / badminton / I / afternoon / every

→

Question 41: you / like / to / would / a ski resort / go to

→

Question 42: doing / I / time / spend / origami

→

II. Rewrite sentences without changing their meaning (43–47)

Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, chỉ gõ phần từ còn thiếu vào ô:

Question 43. I like playing badminton.

→ I am keen

Question 44. She enjoys doing origami.

→ She is interested

Question 45. We often play sport in the afternoon.

→ We spend

Question 46. He loves skiing very much.

→ He is fond

Question 47. I like relaxing at home.

→ I enjoy

MINI REVIEW: Cấu Trúc Trọng Tâm Unit 1 - Leisure Time

1. Cấu trúc chỉ sở thích + V-ing:

  • be keen on + V-ing: Thích / đam mê
  • be interested in + V-ing: Quan tâm / thích
  • be fond of + V-ing: Yêu thích
  • enjoy / fancy + V-ing: Thích thú

2. Cấu trúc thời gian & Lợi ích:

  • spend time + V-ing: Dành thời gian làm gì
  • would like + to-V: Muốn làm gì
  • help (to) reduce stress: Giúp giảm căng thẳng
